name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Best Institution For Research In The Field Of Ageing
targetBeneficiaries: Organizations working in the field of ageing
briefDescription: This central award recognizes institutions for outstanding research and knowledge dissemination in the field of ageing, conferred annually by the President of India.
descriptionMd: The National Award For Senior Citizens (Vayoshreshtha Samman): Best Institution For Research In The Field Of Ageing is a prestigious central award. It aims to recognize and felicitate institutions demonstrating exceptional work in research related to ageing and the dissemination of knowledge in this crucial field. The scheme encourages high-quality research and contributes to a better understanding of issues affecting senior citizens.
benefitsMd:
*   Recognition from the Hon'ble President of India.
*   Prestige and honor as a leading institution in ageing research.
*   Acknowledgement for outstanding work in research and knowledge dissemination.
*   Award conferred annually on October 1st.
eligibilityMd:
*   Institutions must have a record of outstanding work in research.
*   Institutions must demonstrate work in the field of ageing.
*   Institutions must have a record in the dissemination of knowledge in the field of ageing.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
